licoes.titulo: Review 1: work, life stories and plans
licoes.objectivo: Rever as unidades 1 a 3 do A2: os dois presentes, os dois passados e os três futuros, com os erros mais comuns.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: I usually [support] the staff, but this month [I'm working] on a big project.

exercicios.enunciado: Choose the correct sentence.
You want to know about her personality. Choose the question.
Choose the correct sentence.
Choose the correct question.
Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: I [was checking] the cables when the power went off.

exercicios.enunciado: Choose the correct sentence.
"The phone's ringing!" — Choose the best answer.
It's in your diary: Saturday, lunch with your aunt. Choose the sentence.

opcoes.texto: On Saturday I'm having lunch with my aunt.
On Saturday I have lunch with my aunt yesterday.
On Saturday I had lunch with my aunt next week.

exercicios.frase: I was checking the cables on the third floor when the power went off. The UPS didn't arrive on time, so we had to stop for two hours.
exercicios.enunciado: Why did they have to stop?

opcoes.texto: The power went off, and the UPS wasn't there.

exercicios.frase: I usually support the staff, but this month I'm working on a big project.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita: present simple e present continuous lado a lado.
What do you usually do at work, and what are you working on these days?
exercicios.resposta: I usually answer clients' emails and check orders. These days I'm preparing the end-of-year report, so I'm very busy.
exercicios.contexto: O habitual e o deste período.

exercicios.enunciado: Tell me about a difficult moment this year. What were you doing when it happened?
exercicios.resposta: I was driving to a meeting when my car stopped. So I called a taxi. In the end, I arrived only ten minutes late.
exercicios.contexto: Past continuous, when e in the end.

licoes.titulo: Review 1: choosing, health and the exam
licoes.objectivo: Rever as unidades 4 e 5 do A2 e as estratégias do exame.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: Projector B is [much] cheaper, but it isn't as bright [as] Projector A.

exercicios.enunciado: Choose the correct sentence.

opcoes.texto: I need some information about the price.
I need some informations about the price.
I need an information about the price.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
Choose the correct sentence.
Não é preciso usar gravata. Choose the sentence.

opcoes.texto: You don't have to wear a tie.
You haven't to wear a tie.

exercicios.enunciado: É proibido fumar aqui. Choose the sentence.

opcoes.texto: You don't have to smoke here.

exercicios.enunciado: You need time to think in the exam. What do you say?
You're not sure what the examiner means by "background". What do you say?

exercicios.frase: I recommend Projector B. It isn't as bright as Projector A, but it's much cheaper, and the warranty is longer — three years.
exercicios.enunciado: Why does Lurdes recommend Projector B?

opcoes.texto: It's cheaper, and the warranty is longer.

exercicios.frase: That's a good question. Well… Do you mean my studies?
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita as duas estratégias novas.
I'm your manager. Laptop A: 600 000 Kz, light, battery for ten hours. Laptop B: 450 000 Kz, heavier, battery for five hours. Which one do you recommend for the sales team?
exercicios.resposta: I recommend Laptop A. It's more expensive, but it's much lighter, and the battery lasts ten hours, not five. The sales team travels a lot. The only disadvantage is the price.

exercicios.enunciado: I'm your colleague. I have back pain, and tomorrow I have to drive to Benguela for work. What should I do?
exercicios.resposta: You should see a doctor today. You don't have to drive — why don't you take the bus? I'll tell the manager.
exercicios.contexto: should, don't have to e uma oferta com will.
